Overview

Shinobi (Eternal) is a MythicalMythical unit. He can only be obtained by evolving Shinobi (Awakened).

Evolving

Shinobi (Eternal) can be evolved from Shinobi (Awakened) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Shinobi (Awakened)
x50 Ninja Scroll (Fire)
x50 Ninja Scroll (Water)
x50 Ninja Scroll (Wood)
x12 Star Fruit
x4 Star Fruit (Blue)
x3 Star Fruit (Pink)
x3 Star Fruit (Green)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Shinobi (Eternal)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 7500 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • Since update 18.0 you can equip the Mangekyō Eye to any character including to this unit.
  • His shiny skin is based from his Anniversary skin in Naruto to Boruto: Shinobi Striker.
  • His shiny's mask is not affected by the Golden trait.
  • Takedowns refer to kills or assists.
